segments.he:
א.

הַמִּתְבָּרֵךְ צָרִיךְ לִתֵּן לַמְבָרֵךְ אֵיזֶה מַתָּנָה.
segments.en: One who is accustomed to saying good tidings, he is enclothed with an aspect of Eliyahu  (Elijah) .

segments.he:
ב.

אַל תְּהִי בִּרְכַּת גּוֹי קַלָּה בְּעֵינֶיךָ.
segments.en: Do not bear bad tidings, for due to bad tidings numerous people have passed away.

segments.he:
ג.

מִי שֶׁמְּקָרֵב אֶת הָרְחוֹקִים לַעֲבוֹדַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ הַבְּרָכוֹת מְסוּרִים בְּיָדוֹ.
segments.en: One who fulfills a commandment 'as it was said'  (t.n. There are different interpretations as to what this demands. The Maharsha explains that it means – for the sake of Heaven. The Maharal explains it means – in completion, exactly as it was commanded) , evil tidings do not come to him, and the Holy One, Blessed be He, decrees, and he annuls.
One who bears evil tidings falls into small-mindedness.
One who is accustomed to bear good tidings, through this his feet will not hurt him.
The one who is blessed should give the one who blessed him a gift.
The blessing of a non-Jew should not be insignificant in your eyes.
